original_assessment.marker_limitation: An unrecognized keyword does not prove missing audio; inspect saved WebM and distinguish ASR substitutions from capture loss.
original_assessment.original_remaining: Real Zoom, minimum agreed hardware, independent human corpus, CPU stress and isolated nearly-full volume not tested.
original_assessment.phrase_latency_method: Conservative upper bound from chunk-end lag plus maximum decoded chunk duration; no word-level timing acceptance.
